rationale: The benchmark candidate spans twelve governance scenarios across three hosts, affects product semantics and runtime behavior, crosses host boundaries, and involves six canonical owners across eight source and eight derived paths. Deterministic propagation is absent. This breadth and cross-owner runtime impact require structured delivery; the result is non-authorizing and is not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Brownfield context includes 6 canonical owners, 8 source paths, and 8 derived paths.
Impacts include product semantics, runtime, and cross-host behavior.
Deterministic validation is available, but deterministic propagation is false.
verified_change is ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived
compact_delivery is ineligible because no completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are supplied.
Any impact beyond the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
